description: Available UI components for uiDirective.components[]. Each item picks exactly one ACTIVE branch below (discriminated by componentId) and its data payload. Non-escalation turns start uiDirective with RESPONSE_TEXT; append visual components for structure/data. On escalation, uiDirective is null and thinkingText is emitted instead. Emit a visual component when input is faster than typing, when visualizing computed structure, or when a phase-gate is required; do not emit one when text suffices, mid-conversation with no structure needed, or when a visual would add no value. Input-type selection (requiredInputs.type to componentId): CURRENCY/NUMBER default to VALUE_INPUT with inputType SLIDER if bounded else TEXT; PERCENTAGE is always VALUE_INPUT with inputType SLIDER (0-100); DURATION defaults to VALUE_INPUT with inputType TEXT, upgrading to TIERED_SELECTOR if the valid set is small (omit per-item description for flat chip style); BOOLEAN is TIERED_SELECTOR with fixed Yes/No options (no per-item description needed); CHOICE_SIMPLE is TIERED_SELECTOR with self-explanatory labels, omit per-item description (2-6 options, flat chip mode); CHOICE_TIERED is TIERED_SELECTOR with per-item title+description (2-5 options, full card mode) or when topic is sensitive; MULTIPLE_FIELDS is FORM_GROUP grouping 2+ related inputs under one submitAction; PHASE_GATE is REVIEW_CARD with rows (populate rows + confirmAction + editAction; optionally add headline as summary KPI); SHOW_RESULT computed target/score/recommendation is REVIEW_CARD without rows (populate headline + attribution + acknowledgeAction; optionally add editAction for adjust); SHOW_STATUS goal/plan/profile state is REVIEW_CARD (headline + rows or attribution + statusBadge + acknowledgeAction; optionally add editAction); SHOW_CONFIRMATION post-action receipt is REVIEW_CARD (headline + rows + acknowledgeAction); SHOW_RESULT proportional split is ALLOCATION_BAR; SHOW_RESULT savings/contribution plan is MILESTONE_PLAN. [MVP-INACTIVE mappings not injected at runtime: CLASSIFICATION -> INTERACTIVE_SORTER.]
x-mvp-filter-note: BE filters x-inactive-defs components at injection time. anyOf + $defs contain only ACTIVE components included in the runtime response schema. x-inactive-anyOf + x-inactive-defs hold MVP-deferred components. To promote: move $ref from x-inactive-anyOf to anyOf, move definition from x-inactive-defs to $defs.

EntityMeta.description: Entity context for this component. Required for input components; null for display-only components.

entityGroupId.description: Entity group this component collects for (e.g., 'person_1', 'person_2', 'household_1').

relationshipToUser.description: The entity's relationship to the primary user.

uiActionType.description: Frontend-only affordance triggered instead of a backend call, e.g. focusing the chat input.

ComponentAction.description: The action object a CTA-bearing component fills. GUIDED_COMPLETION requires guidanceMarker and drives backend routing and conversation state; STANDARD_COMPLETION's guidanceMarker is optional and triggers no guided routing.

guidanceMarker.description: Backend routing marker. Required when actionType is GUIDED_COMPLETION; omit or null for STANDARD_COMPLETION.

label.description: Button label shown to the user.

text.description: User-facing message in valid markdown format only, as per MODE.

_OptionSelector_REMOVED.description: Consolidated into TIERED_SELECTOR as of 2026-08-11. TIERED_SELECTOR is now a logical superset: per-item description is optional (flat chip mode) and component-level title/description are optional. Use TIERED_SELECTOR for all former OPTION_SELECTOR use cases.

data.description: Single numeric or currency value (CURRENCY, PERCENTAGE, NUMBER, DURATION) via slider or text field. CTA notes: submitAction — explicit button to confirm entered value.

description.description: Context explaining why this is asked or what it includes.

exclusions.description: Explicitly state what NOT to include, referencing past or future fields that might be asked later.

smartDefault.description: Pre-positions slider. Derive from userContext profile (income, city, household). Null = centered.

TieredSelector.description: Unified selector component covering both flat chip-style picks (former OPTION_SELECTOR) and full card-style tiered picks. Render mode is driven by whether per-item description is present: omit description on all items for flat chip UI (BOOLEAN, CHOICE_SIMPLE, small-set DURATION); include description on all items for full card UI (CHOICE_TIERED, sensitive topics). 2-6 items total. CTA notes: submitAction — fires automatically on item tap, UI handles trigger; skipAction — populate only when skipOption is present, else omit.

title.description: Optional component header — 2-5 words, user-facing. Omit when the preceding RESPONSE_TEXT already frames the question.

description.description: Optional context explaining why this is being asked or what it covers. Omit when the question is self-evident.

items.description: 2-6 selectable items. Omit per-item description on all items for flat chip rendering; include it on all items for full card rendering. Do not mix — either all items have description or none do.

description.description: One-line explanation shown below the label in full card mode. Omit on all items for flat chip mode.

icon.description: Optional emoji displayed alongside the label.

skipOption.description: Include only when skipping is genuinely valid for this field (e.g., 'Not sure', 'Skip for now'). Omit otherwise.

icon.description: Optional emoji displayed alongside the skip label.

skipAction.description: Populate only when skipOption is present; omit otherwise.

data.description: Collect 2+ related inputs presented one at a time within a single form. Submit is at form level, not per-component. All input component types are valid children. FORM_GROUP cannot be nested inside another FORM_GROUP. Each child's own action slot (submitAction/skipAction) must be null — the form owns the single submit. CTA notes: submitAction — single submit for the entire form.

components.description: Children use the identical envelope-and-data shape as top-level uiDirective.components entries.

ReviewCard.description: Structured summary card for presenting titled, non-editable information in card layout. Content-driven rendering: rows present → tabular detail (field-value pairs); attribution present → factor breakdown; headline alone → hero value card. Cross-content fields: icon, headline, statusBadge, and editAction are available in all modes. Example use cases: (1) Phase-gate review — user confirms collected data (rows + confirmAction + editAction); (2) Computed result — reveal target/score (headline + attribution + acknowledgeAction); (3) Status summary — current state of goal/plan (headline + rows + statusBadge + acknowledgeAction); (4) Confirmation receipt — post-action summary (headline + rows + acknowledgeAction); (5) Profile/insight reveal — computed profile or insight (headline + attribution or rows + acknowledgeAction).

data.description: title is always required. Populate content fields by use case: (a) Phase-gate review: rows + confirmAction + editAction; optionally headline as summary KPI and icon. (b) Computed result: headline + attribution + acknowledgeAction; optionally editAction for adjust and secondaryAction for explore. (c) Status summary: headline + rows + statusBadge + acknowledgeAction; optionally editAction. (d) Confirmation receipt: headline + rows + acknowledgeAction. (e) Profile/insight reveal: headline + attribution or rows + acknowledgeAction. CTA notes — confirmAction: affirms all values are correct (phase-gate only); acknowledgeAction: signals user has absorbed the information, non-committal (all non-phase-gate use cases); editAction: revise a field or input (any use case); secondaryAction: detail or explore-scenario affordance (optional, any non-phase-gate use case).

icon.description: Optional emoji representing the card domain. Adds visual personality, e.g., '💰' for budget review, '🎯' for a computed target, '✅' for confirmation, '📊' for status.

statusBadge.description: Optional status indicator for goal tracking, plan state, profile classification, or any contextual state label. Omit when no status semantics apply (e.g., phase-gate review, one-off result reveal).

label.description: Short status text, e.g., 'On Track', 'Moderate', 'Completed', '50% Funded'.

tone.description: Visual tone for the badge. Frontend maps to color/icon treatment.

title.description: Card header. Phase-gate: e.g., 'Your Profile', 'Monthly Expenses'. Result: conversational and specific, e.g., 'Your Emergency Fund Target'.

headline.description: Primary value display. Required for result, status, confirmation, and insight use cases. Optional for phase-gate (summary KPI above rows, e.g., total income hero number). Omit when no single value meaningfully summarises the card content.

value.description: Formatted primary value, e.g., '₹2,40,000' or '82/100' or '₹85,000/month'.

subtitle.description: Contextual qualifier, e.g., '~6 months of essential expenses' or 'Total monthly outflow'.

rows.description: Tabular content block — field-value pairs. Use for phase-gate review (collected fields for confirmation — confirmAction and editAction are required in this case), status detail (current state fields), confirmation receipts (committed values), or structured breakdowns. Omit when attribution alone suffices.

attribution.description: Factor breakdown explaining how a computed value was derived or what influenced a classification/profile. Typical in result and profile/insight use cases. Omit when rows alone convey the detail.

header.description: Section header, e.g., 'How we got here'.

confirmAction.description: Phase-gate use case only. Required when rows represents collected fields for user confirmation. Affirms all reviewed values are correct. Omit for all other use cases — use acknowledgeAction instead.

acknowledgeAction.description: Non-committal acknowledgement. Required for result, status, confirmation, and insight use cases (any use case except phase-gate). Signals user has absorbed the information. Label guidance: 'Got it', 'Understood', 'Done', 'Continue'.

editAction.description: Available in all use cases. Phase-gate (required): signals intent to change a reviewed field, opens conversational flow. Result/status/profile (optional): revise an input that fed the computation or update a tracked parameter.

secondaryAction.description: Optional in any non-phase-gate use case. Contextual non-edit action: detail (deeper breakdown), explore_scenario, or navigate. Omit if it adds no value. Do not use in phase-gate mode (editAction covers the secondary need there).

_ResultReveal_REMOVED.description: Consolidated into REVIEW_CARD as of 2026-08-11. REVIEW_CARD is now a logical superset: populate headline + attribution + acknowledgeAction for result mode (former RESULT_REVEAL behaviour); populate rows + confirmAction + editAction for phase-gate mode (original REVIEW_CARD behaviour).

data.description: SHOW_RESULT: proportional split or allocation breakdown across 2-5 categories. CTA notes: primaryAction — pick acknowledge (informational) or confirm (decision point) based on context; secondaryAction — pick adjust or explore_scenario based on context; omit if neither adds value.

vehicle.description: Instrument or category, e.g., 'Savings Account', 'Equity MF'.

data.description: SHOW_RESULT: savings/contribution plan with an editable commitment headline + milestone timeline with dates. CTA notes: inlineEditAction — triggered by headline value edit event, not a button; UI handles trigger; primaryAction — pick acknowledge (seen the plan) or confirm (commits to the plan) based on context.

editable.description: Whether user can inline-edit this value.

editConfig.description: Config for inline editor (slider range, step, etc.).

PlanPreviewCard.description: Backend-authored. Not offered as a model-authored branch of any generator's component union — documented here for frontend consumers only. Emitted when generating or updating a planOverview; its data is derived server-side from the stamped PlanOverview, never authored by the model.

scopeNote.description: What the plan covers and what the user gets at the end. 1-2 sentences.

description.description: 1-2 sentences: what happens in this phase and why it matters for the goal.

data.description: CTA notes: approvalAction — approves the plan to begin execution; editAction — signals intent to modify the plan structure.

CLASSIFICATION - user categorises, prioritises, or sorts a set of items into labelled buckets. 2-4 categories, 4-10 items. Result map: {categoryValue: [itemLabels]}. CTA notes: submitAction — fires when all items are sorted.

instruction.description: Task framing, e.g., 'Tap each scenario to sort it'.

data.description: Mid-flow read-only insight card. CTA notes: rowAction — optional per-row tap for expand-on-demand; omit if row is not tappable.

RECOMMEND: numbered action steps for the user to execute. Optional per-step action — not every step needs one. No component-level action. CTA notes: stepAction — optional per-step; pick start_journey, explain, or save based on context.
Non-blocking explanatory prose below the preceding component - for factual disclosures, regulatory notes, or 'good to know' context.

Optional enhancement or rider the user can accept or skip. resolvedState is null on initial emit; populate on the follow-up turn after user accepts and any computation completes. CTA notes: acceptAction — conveys opting in to the add-on; declineAction — conveys skipping without negativity, lower visual weight; keepAction — confirms keeping the processed add-on (in resolvedState); removeAction — removes the add-on, lower visual weight (in resolvedState).

inputConfig.description: Populate only if accepting needs user input: componentId plus that component's own data shape from the input palette.

resolvedState.description: Null on initial emit. Populated on follow-up turn after user accepts.

data.description: All active goals with health indicators. CTA notes: goalTapAction — per-goal tap to view detail; addGoalAction — initiates a new goal journey.

Single goal deep-dive with projection and what-if. CTA notes: primaryAction — requests AI recommendation for this goal; secondaryAction — pick adjust (update goal parameters) or explore_scenario (what-if); omit if neither adds value.

SHOW_RESULT from scenario planning - side-by-side comparison of two options. CTA notes: selectAction — selects this scenario as the chosen path; exploreAction — triggers exploration of another scenario variation; adviseAction — requests AI recommendation on which scenario to choose.
